## Presentations

| Course Title | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| [Maven: A Comprehensive Training Course](tech/maven/maven.qmd) | Establishes a solid foundation in Apache Maven fundamentals (POM, lifecycle, dependency management) and advanced topics (profiles, multi-module projects, optimization, security). |
| [DevOps Essentials](tech/devops/devops.qmd) | Overview of modern DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automation toolchains, and collaborative workflows. |
| [Modern JavaScript (ES6+)](tech/es6/es6.qmd) | Comprehensive overview of ES6 features: let/const, arrow functions, destructuring, template literals, modules, promises, and rest/spread. |
| [ReactJS & State Management](tech/reactjs/react.qmd) | Deep dive into React fundamentals, component design, state & props, styling, Redux, React Router, and unit testing. |
| [GenAI: LLM Application Development](tech/genai/intro/index.qmd) | Complete guide to LLM app development: 2026 foundation model landscape, prompt engineering, LangChain LCEL, embeddings, ChromaDB, advanced hybrid RAG with reranking, and OWASP security. |
| [GenAI: Local LLMs PoC](tech/genai/poc/localllms.qmd) | Exploring self-hosted, quantized local open-source models, quantization techniques, and privacy-preserving prototyping. |
| [Python Programming](tech/python/index.qmd) | Introduction to core Python programming concepts and regular expression processing. |
| [Python for AI Engineers](tech/python-ai/index.qmd) | Prerequisite bootcamp for agent frameworks (LangGraph, Strands, ADK): uv, typing, Pydantic, async, design patterns, testing, performance, and packaging. |
| [Agentic AI Engineering Bootcamp](tech/agentic-ai/index.qmd) | 3-day hands-on intensive on building autonomous, tool-using systems: ReAct loops, LangGraph, Google Gen AI ADK, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent skills, evaluation, observability, and security. |
